propositions.name: Vintage
propositions.claim: With documents, outcome and construction rule fixed, a novelty measure built from the current record is more positively associated with the outcome than the same measure built from the record as published.

propositions.name: Outcome dependence
propositions.claim: Revision of a record is related to what happened to that record and not merely later than it.
propositions.refuted_by: in the aggregate, a vintage difference no larger than outcome-blind revision would produce; at the level of the record, an association between provably post-decision information and the decision inside the preregistered equivalence band
propositions.state: supported in the aggregate, not at the level of the record

propositions.name: Reconstruction
propositions.claim: Part of the revision is related to what the field later made of the invention.
propositions.refuted_by: revision that postdates a closed observation window and is unrelated to the later recognition of the individual record
